themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, conduct analyses, and evolve their own capabilities.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Articles discussing AI tools that help developers write, debug, and understand code, including discussions of their vulnerabilities and capabilities.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Covers a broad range of AI-powered platforms and tools used to facilitate and enhance various stages of research, from data collection to analysis.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Explores the application of AI in the design process, including AI-generated design elements, AI's impact on design workflows, and AI's role in user interface prototyping.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Details AI's ability to condense large amounts of information into concise summaries, applicable to research papers, meetings, and data analysis.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Focuses on how AI is used to automate or enhance the process of testing software, products, and user experiences for usability and performance.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Articles that compare, review, and assess the effectiveness of various AI tools and platforms for specific applications.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Investigates user interactions with AI chatbots, including their impact on cognition, accuracy, addiction, and potential for misinformation.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI is affecting jobs, employment, skills, and the overall workforce, including concerns about job displacement and the need for retraining.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discusses the creation and use of AI-generated personas or simulated users for testing and research purposes.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
